prompt:
The section sections/event-banner-status.liquid renders an event banner with a title and an optional call-to-action link. Its schema already defines every setting you need. Do not change the schema block: keep it byte-for-byte. Add a status badge and hide the call-to-action when the event cannot be booked. Inputs (all under section.settings, every key is always present): - title: string or null - is_cancelled: boolean - is_sold_out: boolean - days_until: integer or null. Negative means the event is in the past. - button_label: string or null - button_link: string or null Existing behavior to keep: - The title is section.settings.title, or "Upcoming event" when it is null or an empty string. It is HTML-escaped. - The CTA is `LABEL`. LINK and LABEL are HTML-escaped. - The CTA requires both button_label and button_link to be non-null and non-empty. Badge rules. Apply the first rule that matches, in this priority order: 1. is_cancelled is true: text "Cancelled", modifier "cancelled". 2. days_until is not null and is less than 0: text "Ended", modifier "ended". This applies even when is_sold_out is true. 3. is_sold_out is true: text "Sold out", modifier "sold-out". 4. days_until is not null, and is_cancelled and is_sold_out are false: - 0 gives text "Today". - 1 gives text "Tomorrow". - 2 through 7 inclusive gives text "In N days", for example "In 3 days". - All of these use modifier "soon". - Values greater than 7 give no badge. 5. Otherwise there is no badge. This includes days_until null with no other flags. The badge markup is `TEXT`. When rule 1, 2 or 3 applies (cancelled, ended or sold out), the CTA must NOT be rendered, even if label and link are present. In all other cases the CTA follows the existing rule. Output is a single line with no whitespace between tags: `

TITLE

` then the badge (if any), then the CTA (if any), then `
`. The template must produce no other output: no leading or trailing whitespace or newlines. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/event-banner-status.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
